comments.note: tests/bootstrap.php was glob-loading TestClasses/ to fix InMemoryStorage not being discoverable — a known gap from WP-001 QA (noted '...Test WPs that use it must either rely on WP-008 running first or manually require the file'). Applied the require_once glob fix now rather than deferring. No impact on existing tests.
getItemsPerPage with a non-null default correctly receives the default back from InMemoryStorage when the key is absent, then casts it to int — type-safe and correct. No issue.
Per-gridID storage isolation confirmed: two GridSettings instances sharing the same InMemoryStorage but different grid IDs do not overwrite each other's values.

summary: GridSettings.php is clean, minimal, and correct. declare(strict_types=1) present. getItemsPerPage() correctly casts mixed storage return to ?int. setItemsPerPage() is fluent (returns self). No over-engineering.
GridSettingsTest.php covers all 4 ACs plus 2 meaningful edge cases (default-override, per-gridID isolation). Uses assertSame throughout. setUp() ensures per-test isolation.
tests/bootstrap.php glob-loading fix is pragmatic. One non-blocking gap: glob() can return false on system failure, causing a TypeError in PHP 8 foreach. Fix: glob(...) ?: [].
All acceptance criteria met as confirmed by QA. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: tests/bootstrap.php: glob() can return false on system failure. foreach(false as ...) throws TypeError in PHP 8+. Fix: change to foreach(glob(...DIR__.'/TestClasses/*.php') ?: [] as $file). Non-blocking — only affects test harness.

GridSettings uses the string literal 'items_per_page' directly in two methods. Consider a private const KEY_ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 'items_per_page' if the number of settings grows — prevents typo drift. Non-blocking for WP-002 scope.
No observations on architecture or security — code is clean and consistent. GridSettings is a correctly scoped, typed wrapper with no surprising side effects.
